Why AKG+Life

Built for Indian Conditions

India's power grid is unpredictable. AKG+Life stabilizers are engineered to handle the worst voltage fluctuations while protecting your valuable appliances.

Micro-Controlled Technology

Electronic circuit ensures positive relay switching — more reliable and durable than mechanical types.

Low Heat Generation

Heavy-duty transformers with high-class vacuum varnish ensure minimum heating and energy loss.

6-Stage Powder Coating

Pre-treated powder-coated outer cabinet for long-lasting durability in all weather conditions.

High/Low Voltage Trip

Auto cut-off with time-delay relay for complete appliance protection.

LED/LCD Display

Real-time voltage monitoring with bright digital display panel.

IS Standards Tested

Rigorously tested as per Indian Standards for safety & reliability.

Cu & Al Models

Available in both Copper and Aluminium winding variants.

About AKG+Life

Technology That Cares for Your Life. India's leading voltage stabilizer brand, backed by Shree Shyam Corp.

Our Story

Shree Shyam Corp

AKG+Life is a brand of Shree Shyam Corp, an ISO 9001:2015 certified Indian company headquartered in the heart of Delhi's industrial belt. We manufacture high-quality electronic voltage stabilizers trusted by homes and businesses across India.

Our brand philosophy — "Technology That Cares for Your Life" — drives every product we engineer. We harness the latest micro-controlled technology to deliver stabilizers that are smarter, safer and more durable than conventional products.

Available in both Copper and Aluminium winding models, our entire range is rigorously tested as per IS standards before leaving our factory.
